pullRequests.head: feat/going-commando-integration
pullRequests.body:
Going Commando update
Sync games/rac2/ntsc from rac2-decomp b300787daa to 940aaf1b0e, after merging contributor PRs #9, #10, #11 and #12.

Exact integrated C increases from 277,780 to 311,500 / 48,788,176 bytes: +33,720 bytes, now 0.6385%.
Includes region-aware tooling, objdiff report validation, reviewed RAC1 research notes, and the isolated experimental PAL functional port. The port and research add zero matching credit.
Preserves OpenRAC's excluded header, sanitized references, host wrappers…

commits.headline: build(rac4): mount all of OpenRAC in the build container
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Inside OpenRAC, tools/docker/run.sh mounts the repository's top level
instead of games/rac4/ntsc alone, so the toolchain link to the shared
toolchains/ resolves in the container, and it uses rac1/pal's locally
built image (rac1-build) when its own name is not there. A standalone
checkout behaves as before.

commits.headline: feat(tools): map functions across the games
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
tools/xmap.py indexes every function of every program a version has
(boot executable, frontend, level overlays), counts a function that
repeats across levels once, and compares versions:

- scan: cuts each code section into functions the same way for every
  game and fingerprints each twice: strict (only address fields masked,
  the same function elsewhere) and shape (constants and struct offsets
  masked too, a relative). It also fingerprints the functions as each
  project cuts and lists…

CI runs the check.

commits.headline: feat(tools): pair functions that changed a little between versions
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
For the resident programs (boot executable, frontend), xmap.py now also
pairs functions that share neither fingerprint: between two functions
unchanged and in the same order in both versions, the ones in between are
paired in order when their shape-masked instructions are at least 80%
alike. `report` adds the table, and `ports` lists them as `similar` with
the ratio.

On 2026-10-04 that adds, for example, 108 functions (50 KB) between
rac1/pal and rac2's boots and 93 (24 KB) between rac3 and…

commits.headline: feat(rac1/ntsc): build on an Apple Silicon Mac under rac1/pal's Wine 8
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The project's container cannot start its 32-bit Windows tools on an emulated
amd64 host (Wine 9, status c0000018, under Rosetta and under QEMU). host/run.sh
runs the same container with the 32-bit Wine 8 of rac1/pal's image mounted in
and used through RNC_WINE (host/wine8-chroot.sh).

Measured on 2026-10-04 at e1db4cd with Rosetta on: setup.sh completes, make elf
rebuilds the boot ELF byte for byte (SHA-256 e050581032e4...), and make
overlays reports all 1540 overlay functions in C matching…

commits.headline: feat(tools): port a matched function into a version with the same code
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
tools/port.py takes a function one project has matched and another version
holds unchanged (the `same` rows of shared/xmap/ports), slices its C and the
declarations it needs out of the source project's file, and renames every
symbol to the target's. --check then runs the target project's own check on
each candidate and adjusts declarations its file already has.

Symbols are translated from the code: the two functions are the same
instructions, so the n-th address one forms is the n-th the other…

commits.headline: feat(tools): port in both directions between rac1's two projects
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
port.py now takes each version's rules from its game.json: how it names an
address, whether it declares symbols by plain names (rac1/pal) or under
private names with assembler labels (rac1/ntsc), how it marks small data, and
how its check runs. rac1/ntsc's check puts a candidate under the NON_MATCHING
guard of its own file, as that project keeps pending C, and takes it out
again; what passes is also written as a patch against its tree.

Found while measuring: a declaration with several names is…

commits.headline: fix(tools): dead padding no longer hides an address from the port tool
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
mips.references seeded code nothing reaches (the nop after an unconditional
branch) with an empty state and let it flow on, which wiped the top halves the
code after it really holds. In sceLseek that hid one global; the port then
took a constant (addr | 0x20000000) for a reference to it and left the US
address in. rac1/pal's masked check passed it; its linked build showed 3 bytes
off. Dead code now passes nothing on, and a reference a megabyte or more above
every symbol is not attributed to…
